description: Delete a file from the router filesystem by name. Idempotent: returns not_found gracefully if the file does not exist.

confirmationToken.description: Token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Re-submit the identical call with this token to confirm the destructive action.

dryRun.description: Preview deletion without removing the file

name.description: Exact file name on the router (e.g. flash/backup.backup)

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

name: delete_file
title: Delete File
